title: Gate shell extraction and TLAS rebuilds on timeline progress + timeout
purpose: Prevent heavy extraction/build loops when timeline hasn’t advanced or shells unchanged, which can lead to stalls and silent exits.

steps.detail: Track last signaled and last observed timeline values in VolumeRenderer. Only call updateShellTLASWithSync if (lastObserved < lastSignaled).
Hash a small sample of coarse density mip0 to detect meaningful change; skip extraction if unchanged for K frames.
If timeline hasn’t progressed for T ms, log a warning once and stop further extraction attempts until user toggles or density changes.

acceptance: No rapid extraction loops in logs
